training: 52 reviewed endpoint frames, 12 positive boxes and 40 negatives; 8 original train parents. Fixed 60 epochs, last checkpoint, no validation epoch/threshold selection.
supplemental: Use verified warm_sepia, cool_camera and cctv_low_quality versions of reviewed training parents only. Draw original-or-variant per point per epoch, without multiplying source weight. All 40 validation descendants prohibited. Synthetic scenarios remain unlabelled for this target and are not fitted.
pipeline: Existing frozen multiview R3D predicts client and handover. New endpoint banknote detector replaces only the cash score. Existing causal sequence parameters remain unchanged.
evaluation: All 10 unchanged real validation videos scanned; 39 known cash endpoints scored. Separately report sampled visual sequence performance on reviewed X-2/X-31/X-38/X-39; do not claim complete legal-event ground truth. Original X-38 reference31s remains unchanged.
limitations: Validation repeatedly inspected during development, not independent test.
Bounding rectangles supervise a visual surrogate, not cash ownership or accounting.
Four synthetic originals do not constitute eight independent real examples.
No automatic deployment or legal verdict based solely on this experiment.
